property_summary: After calling c.go with any ether amount, either the call reverts or c.owner remains unchanged and c's balance is zero (all funds forwarded out).
Calling c.go forwards all received ether out of contract C (so afterwards address(c).balance == 0) unless the call reverts; additionally the owner address never becomes the zero address.

property_summary: Calling c.go either reverts or leaves c.owner unchanged and transfers any ether out of C so address(c).balance == 0 after a successful call.

If c.go succeeds (does not revert) when invoked with any amount, then the contract's owner remains an address (nonzero) and that owner is the sole recipient of the contract's previous balance (i.e., after success the owner's address equals c.owner and address(c).balance == 0 and address(this).balance increased by the forwarded amount).
